guard.collab: visual-omp hosts this chat's live room, so changing the room from omp would disconnect the app from the chat. Invite people from Share instead.
guard.join: Joining another room would replace this chat with someone else's session, and visual-omp can't open another person's chat as a guest yet.
guard.move: omp would move this session to another folder while the chat is open here, which visual-omp can't follow. Start a chat in the other folder instead.
guard.worktree: omp would move this session into a new worktree while the chat is open here, which visual-omp can't follow. A worktree created from visual-omp opens in its own chat.
guard.forkTerminal: omp opens that fork in a terminal multiplexer pane, window or tab, and visual-omp has none. A plain fork opens the copy in a new tab here.
guard.unsavedBody: omp hasn't written a session file for it, so there's nothing to delete.

voice.stop: Stop and insert what you said
voice.nothingBody: Check the microphone, or set up voice if this is the first time.
voice.ready: Voice input is on. Click the microphone and talk.
voice.consentBody: omp turns what you say into text in this box. You check it, then send.
voice.consentLocal: By default the speech model runs on this computer, so your voice isn't uploaded.
voice.consentDownload: The first time, omp downloads the speech model (a few hundred MB). "Set up voice" lets you pick a model and language.
voice.consentRestart: This chat restarts once so omp picks up the change. Nothing is lost.
voice.clearTuiFirst: There's an unsent message in omp's editor. Send it or clear it before dictating.
